Read the denominators.

All measurements include startup; warmup is not excluded. Rollout throughput counts committed prompt-group jobs, including speculative samples not consumed by the learner. Idle fractions use reported worker waiting + busy intervals. End-to-end latency includes queueing, generation, verification and learning.

CPU bandit runs do not produce language-model tokens. “Not measured” is different from zero. These short acceptance runs do not establish a GPU scaling or framework performance advantage.
